name: Amendments by the committee responsible – separate vote – 81
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on speeding-up environmental assessments
part_text: Annex Ia List of projects in strategic sectors or categories 1. The provisions set out in Article 14 (2a) and (2b) shall apply to the following strategic sectors and categories: a) strategic net-zero technology manufacturing projects and strategic net-zero projects, as defined in Regulation (EU) 2024/1735; b) strategic critical raw material projects as defined in Regulation (EU) 2024/1252; c) projects strengthening the availability and security of supply of critical medicinal products as well as the availability of, and accessibility of, medicinal products of common interest, and amending Regulation (EU) 2024/795 (Critical Medicines Act); d) Regulation (EU) 2026/XXX on a framework of measures for strengthening the Union's semiconductor ecosystem, repealing Regulation (EU) 2023/1781 (Chips Act 2.0); e) the following projects which are part of trans-European transport network as defined in Regulation (EU) 2024/1679 [located on the core or extended core network as depicted in Annex I to that Regulation]: (i) maritime and inland ports and port-related infrastructure, and inland waterways (iii) railways and railway-related infrastructure, in particular high-speed rail; f) [IAA] g) [Biotech] h) [Circular Economy Act]
